Skin b273, hair b306 and main CharacterNPR b1088 have separate dispatch identities. Hemisphere smooth normal is not folded octahedral packing. Expand the full fragment lighting and actual supplied smooth-normal stream.
Render-state verification is restricted to frame-6411 events 968/971/993/997. CPU choice of PreDepth, dynamic projection producer, GBuffer mask and unsupported fog/point-light branches remain open.
Ground receiver is not a hair-on-face shader. Reconstruct SH/AB-LUT producers, packed bias and per-object dither fields; do not substitute a community receiver.
Observed frame-6411 atlas/index/normal/depth bindings and R/G channels do not establish dynamic atlas allocation, depth conventions and all directional/self-shadow production for new poses.
b400 wet reader and LiquidAg b12 snow reader are different. No wet-weather capture closes producer/asset bindings. Expand lighting tail and preserve raw RGBA8 float bits, CP10 selector and UV scale.
RAIN_LIGHTING and snow branches, VerticalOcclusion/depth producer and ScreenRainDropFX Distortion consumer are not fully traced.

Verified input/bindings are restricted to existing frame-6411 evidence. Its 17 compute dispatches are not the raster Bloom wrapper's four passes. Reconcile all kernel paths and producer/resource lifetime contracts before broader approval.

Correct selected variant ordering is documented, but all tone-map/LUT/alpha/dither/final-output permutations and engine-side grading construction remain open. Do not infer colour space from the label LUT or encode twice.

DOF/TAAU/SMAA/lightshaft/lensflare/anamorphic/frosted/sharpen shader existence does not prove activation or order in this capture. Temporal history/reprojection, full algorithms and dispatch producers remain open.
